title: The Day of the Stubborn Mitten
skyStory: A thin waning crescent hangs over the snowbanks, packing its bags in Sagittarius like an archer who has misplaced every single arrow. It shrugs. It will find them next month. Mars, warming its hands by a woodstove somewhere in the cosmos, finds this deeply relatable. February tiptoes in wearing three scarves and announces it is only twenty-eight days long, as if that settles anything.

reading: One mitten will go missing this morning and you will search for it with the focus of a detective in a long coat. It is in the sleeve of the coat you are wearing. The Tiger checks everywhere except its own pockets. File that under lessons.

The rest of the day rewards finishing. You have a half-built thing waiting, maybe a shelf, maybe an email, maybe a plan with four browser tabs. The [[Knight of Wands]] says close three tabs and finish one shelf. When it is done, stand back and admire it out loud, even if the only witness is the kettle.
joel.mission: Finish one small thing you started last week and announce it to the room like a ship launch.
joel.omen: A single glove perched on a fence post. Someone out there is also looking for something, and you will help a stranger before dinner.
joel.stoneWhy: grounding for the great mitten hunt
joel.elementWhy: a month that starts in snowboots

reading: The Wood Rat wakes up already knowing which part of the day will be silly. Probably the meeting that could have been two sentences. Bring a pen you love and doodle a small mountain in the margin while everyone talks in circles.

Later, someone will ask your advice in the hallway, casually, as if it were nothing. It is not nothing. Your Life Path 11 hears the real question underneath the polite one. Answer that one instead, gently, and watch their shoulders drop about two inches. That is your work today, and it counts.
nancy.mission: Draw a tiny mountain somewhere unexpected today, like a sticky note on the fridge, and leave it for someone to discover.
nancy.omen: A crow carrying something shiny. It means a clever idea will land in your lap by Wednesday.

together.text: Each of you names one thing you will finish before February ends. Say it to each other, out loud or by message, then forget about it for a while. The month is short and sneaky, but so are you two.
